name: shipmail
description: Modern email for your business. Inboxes, calendars, newsletters, bookings and an AI assistant, plus transactional email and an API for your agents. Everything on your own domain, in one subscription.

interface.longDescription: Search and triage your inbox, draft and send replies you approve, write and schedule newsletters, manage calendars and booking pages, set up automations, and add domains and mailboxes, all on your own domain through Shipmail's hosted MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread emails and draft replies to the customer ones, but do not send anything.
Find a free 30-minute slot tomorrow afternoon and put a call on my calendar.
Turn this month's changelog into a newsletter and send me a test.
